mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, request_id, type, message) VALUES (#{userId}, #{requestId}, #{type}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id AS notificationId, n.request_id AS requestId, r.title AS requestTitle, n.type AS type, n.message AS message, n.is_read AS `read`, n.created_at AS createdAt FROM notifications n JOIN requests r ON n.request_id = r.request_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
